sources.snippet: Tversky Cross-Calibration Checkpoints These ten inference checkpoints accompany the real-data experiments in Cross-Calibration of Tversky Indices. Each model supplies one set of probability outputs on which the Dice and IoU optimizers are compared. The comparison concerns the equivalence of the two metric-specific decisions, not the absolute segmentation performance of the underlying network.
